description: Utility functions for memoization, version comparison, ID generation, email validation, and input type mapping in the Mattermost Redux project.

methods.name: memoizeResult
methods.description: Creates a memoized version of a function with optional measurement.

methods.name: createIdsSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector with shallow comparison of arguments, optimized for returning arrays of IDs.

methods.name: createShallowSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector with shallow comparison of arguments without memoization of the result.

methods.name: isMinimumServerVersion
methods.description: Checks if the current server version meets or exceeds a specified minimum version.

methods.name: isEmail
methods.description: Validates if a string is a properly formatted email address.

methods.name: getInputTypeFromValueType
methods.description: Maps a custom profile attribute value type to an appropriate HTML input type.
